eindtekst: From a 32-type catalog to a live svelteplot playground: click a card, click a bar, tune the props in the drawer.

stappen.tekst: The Labs catalog: 32 chart types, one card each. Two are built playgrounds so far, the heatmap and the bar chart; the rest are honest placeholders until each gets built.
Open the first built playground. Each card links to that chart type's own page.
A svelteplot BarX over 12 months of synthetic booked hours. This is the shared chart fundament: hover for a tooltip, click a bar to select it, bolt icon for live props.
Click a bar: it turns the design-system green and a mono readout appears next to the title.
The readout shows the month and hours of the selected bar in Geist Mono, because it is data detail.
The bolt button opens the config drawer. The panel is schema-driven and bound straight to the component's props.
Title, subtitle, bar color and chart height are plain bound props: change one and the chart updates instantly. Every chart type gets the same drawer.
